podcast.body: Chuck Berry's song "My Ding-a-Ling" is categorized as a novelty song. "Chuck Berry singing My Dingling is a novelty song."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This novelty song, written by Dave Bartholomew, became Chuck Berry's only number one hit in the 1970s. It is characterized as being as juvenile as its title suggests. "his only number one, with a novelty song by Dave Bartholomew, My Dingling, which if you've not heard it, there's about as juvenile as it sounds."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 67: "Johnny B. Goode", by Chuck Berry

podcast.body: This song by Chuck Berry was a point of contention for some American Top 40 affiliates. Due to its explicit reference to a "ding-a-ling," some stations chose to edit it out or not play it, illustrating the challenges of a national broadcast catering to diverse regional sensibilities. "Some affiliates, for example, would not play my dingaling by Chuck Berry because of, well, his reference to his dingaling, just to give you an idea of the so-called problem."
